context: Asuka guides Ren on formatting a report.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic guidance; writing vocabulary (項目/欄/載せ/引用/著者) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: レポートの書き方を、教えて下さい。
lines.en: Please teach me how to write the report.
lines.style: earnest young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まず、項目ごとに分けましょう。
lines.en: First, let's divide it by item.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 参考にした著者は、どこに載せますか?
lines.en: Where do I list the authors I referenced?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最後の欄に、著者名を載せます。
lines.en: You list author names in the final field.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 引用は、どう書けばいいですか?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 引用は、はっきり区別して載せます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各項目に、欄を作るんですね。
lines.en: So I make a field for each item.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 著者への敬意を、引用で示しましょう。
lines.en: Show respect to authors through quotation.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
